svg.text: Zero-Fixed-Signature Keyed Header Protection • Noise-IKpsk2 + ML-KEM-512 PQ Hybrid • 120s Ratchet Overlap • Self-Certifying IPv6
Anti-DPI Keyed Header Protection (XOR Keystream & SipHash MAC)
RS-FEC Symbol / TUN Packet + 16B Poly1305 Tag
⊕ XOR keystream mask eliminates wire signatures: zero magic bytes or fixed discriminators.
Anti-DPI Guarantee: Pure High-Entropy Random Bytes
Keyed Header Protection eliminates wire signatures; packets appear as pure high-entropy
random bytes to DPI engines (nDPI, Zeek, Suricata).
Constant-time SipHash MAC tag check rejects forged headers in <12ns prior to decode.
DPI Resistance: Pass (0 signatures detected across 4-Engine Oracle)
✓ MTU Budget Compliant: Msg 1 (1,028B) & Msg 2 (948B) < 1,200B OBF_MTU_BUDGET.
• Deadlock-Free Execution: Initiator parses cleartext ct at [4..772], computes
Decaps(dk_A, ct) -> ss, and calls handshake_state.set_psk(2, &ss) into slot 2.
• FIPS 203 §7.2: Modulus (< 3329) validated; IND-CCA2 implicit rejection on tampering.
• Ephemeral Zeroize: Decapsulation keys and intermediate secrets scrubbed on Drop.
PQ Security: Quantum-Safe (FIPS 203 Cat 1 ML-KEM-512 + X25519 Hybrid)
Continuous Forward Secrecy • Zero-Drop Rekey Transition
Epoch N Active (TX + RX Session Keys)
• Seamless Egress Switch: Outbound frames jump to Epoch N+1 immediately on response.
• Dual-Receive Grace Window (110s..130s): Receiver accepts datagrams encrypted under
both Epoch N and Epoch N+1 without packet drops or decryption errors.
• Zeroize on Retire: At t = 130s, Epoch N secrets scrubbed from RAM with Zeroize.
• 0% Packet Loss: Eliminates rekey stalls, head-of-line blocking, and burst drops.
Rotation Guarantee: 0% Dropped Packets During Continuous Key Refresh
Self-Certifying IPv6 ULA (fd00::/8) • Zero Central Authority
Self-Certifying IPv6 Bitfield Breakdown (128 bits / 16 Bytes):
• Self-Certifying Identity: Address IS the public key digest; IP spoofing is impossible.
• Zero Central Infrastructure: Autonomous routing without DHCP, IPAM, or coordinators.
• Collision Resistance: 120-bit BLAKE2s digest provides 2^60 collision resistance floor.
• Zero-Trust Admission: Node identity bound to CA Root Certificate before admission.
• Autonomous Routing: Nodes route directly to fd00::/8 ULA addresses across mesh.
Identity Invariant: Address = 0xfd ‖ BLAKE2s(pubkey)[0..15] (Zero Central IPAM)
Protocol Spec: Noise-IKpsk2 • NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-512 • SipHash-CTR / SipHash-2-4 • ChaCha20-Poly1305 • BLAKE2s
